subject: Partial PO path proposal for Rivertide Labs trial
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice@rivertide.ai>; finance@rivertide.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partial PO path proposal for Rivertide Labs trial

Hi Alice / Rivertide procurement team —

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. We’re excited to get Rivertide set up for the 8-week trial. A couple procurement items to unblock onboarding quickly:

- Our standard flow requires a PO for ongoing subscriptions; however, for short trials we can offer a temporary invoice-first path if we capture the necessary vendor info and an agreed handoff plan to create a PO before any long-term commitment.
- Attached: Redwood vendor onboarding form + a draft SOW that maps to the trial deliverables.

Proposal (ask):
1) Rivertide completes the attached onboarding form and returns it with a W-9 or local tax form.
2) Redwood will allow invoice-based billing for the first billing cycle (trial invoice) up to $12,000, provided Rivertide is added to our temporary allowlist and we receive the completed onboarding package.
3) If the trial converts, procurement will issue a formal PO within 30 days of conversion to cover the subscription going forward.

Can you confirm who should receive the onboarding packet and whether the amount above is acceptable to your team? If Rivertide requires a PO up front regardless of amount, let us know and we’ll escalate to procurement for an approved exception.

Next steps: Alice — can you share the procurement contact and any vendor compliance docs you need (e.g., SOC2, insurance)?

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0199
[Attachment: Redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx] [Attachment: draft_SOW_rivertide_trial.docx]

From: Alice Chen <alice@rivertide.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@rivertide.ai; finance@rivertide.ai
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partial PO path proposal for Rivertide Labs trial

Ben — thanks for the clear proposal. A few clarifications from procurement:

- Rivertide policy generally requires a PO for any vendor engagement. For low-dollar pilots (< $5k) we sometimes accept invoice-only, but our procurement team prefers a PO above that threshold.
- For trials that might exceed $10k we need the vendor to be in our system with a completed vendor form and proof of insurance.

I attached our vendor intake form filled with our procurement contact details. Do you have a point of contact on your side to confirm tax docs and insurance? Also, who should we send invoices to? We use invoices@rivertide.ai internally.

Alice Chen
Head of Business Operations, Rivertide Labs
[Attachment: Rivertide_vendor_form_filled.pdf]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice@rivertide.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partial PO path proposal for Rivertide Labs trial

Thanks Alice — forwarding to Marissa and Laura to weigh in on whether we can flex the threshold.

Marissa / Laura — quick summary: Rivertide prefers PO-first. They can accept invoice routing to invoices@rivertide.ai. Trial estimated cost (max) is $9,600 (usage ceiling we set in the SOW). Can Redwood approve temporary invoice-first for this trial and add Rivertide to a 90-day allowlist while procurement completes their intake? If so we will require: completed onboarding form, W-9, and a certificate of insurance.

Quoted for context:
> On Thu, May 13, 2027 at 11:02 AM Alice Chen <alice@rivertide.ai> wrote:
> Ben — thanks for the clear proposal. A few clarifications from procurement...

Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Partial PO path proposal for Rivertide Labs trial

Folks — I’m comfortable with a conditional, time-boxed invoice-first path for this specific pilot. Proposed guardrails:

- Trial ceiling: $15,000 total (covers the $9,600 estimate and gives a small buffer).
- Timebox: 90 days from onboarding date.
- Required artifacts before invoices are accepted: completed vendor onboarding form, tax document (W-9 or equivalent), proof of insurance.
- If spend > $10k we will require procurement signoff (Laura) to approve the exception in our system; exceptions > $25k need leadership sign-off.
- Payment terms: Net 60 for the trial invoices to allow finance to process while procurement completes PO setup.

I attached a short guidance doc I use for conditional approvals. Once the intake packet is complete Laura, can procurement confirm and mark the vendor as temporarily approved in Coupa?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole | Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: conditional_approval_guidance.pdf]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice@rivertide.ai>, procurement@rivertide.ai
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Partial PO path proposal for Rivertide Labs trial

Ben / Marissa / Alice — I reviewed the request and can approve a temporary invoice-first onboarding lane under the following conditions (Procurement final):

1) Rivertide provides completed onboarding form, W-9, certificate of insurance, and completes a short security checklist (we can accept a SOC2 summary if full SOC2 is not available).
2) Redwood will require an internal ticket (Procure-EXC-4892) logged for the exception and procurement will track the conversion to PO. If trial run is successful, Rivertide must provide a PO within 30 days of the signed commercial agreement.
3) Finance routing: invoices should be sent to invoices@redwood.com with PO placeholder: "TBD - Proc EXC 4892" until PO is issued.
4) Minimum SLA for retention of logs / audit evidence: Rivertide must confirm retention for activity logs for 90 days as part of the trial.

I attached the vendor evidence checklist for your procurement team and some routing instructions. Once Rivertide returns the documents, procurement will do the quick KYC and flip the vendor status to "Temporary Approved" in our system. If any of the required docs are missing we cannot accept invoice-only for amounts above $5k.

Action items:
- Alice: please send completed onboarding packet and insurance cert to procurement@redwood.ai and invoices@redwood.com.
- Ben: confirm SOW billing cap and update the SOW to include invoice instructions.
- Marissa: add exception record Procure-EXC-4892 and track conversion.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor_evidence_checklist.xlsx]
